facts.business: Garnet International Limited is an NBFC principally engaged in investment in securities, with operations in shares and securities trading and textile segments through its subsidiary.

auditor.name: Sarda Soni Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-compliance with Section 186(7) regarding interest provisions on inter-corporate loans and borrowings; Emphasis of matter on unconfirmed balances and trade receivables of Rs. 228.71 lakhs from parties under NCLT.

key_risks: Market, credit, and operational risks tied to capital market returns
Vulnerability to external shocks: geopolitical conflicts, volatile crude oil prices, currency depreciation, global trade tensions
Regulatory classification risk for Type I NBFC due to outstanding inter-corporate borrowings and advances
Significant risk of non-collectability of trade receivables from parties under NCLT
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act; details disclosed in standalone financial statements as per applicable Ind AS.
